title: Electrolyser / hydrogen chain
h1: When could iridium limit PEM electrolysis?
deck: New capacity, catalyst loading and the share of supply available to PEM determine annual iridium requirements. Stack replacement and recycling change them over time.

chokepoint.physics: Iridium is recovered with other PGMs. PEM exposure depends on loading, supply allocation and recycling.
